provenance.description: Effective four-DOF inputs from the ANYhydro derived operator artifact (content hash 72d5c9efa52e..., raw dataset content hash 1b44d45fc7fa..., radiation kernel content hash d810cedfebe9...) with the exact retained DOF order; admitted derived Ainf, projected unmodified hydrostatic stiffness, dry diagonal body masses, zero extra frequency-domain damping, zero forcing (free decay). Explicit derived-operator development import, unqualified.

assumptions: low_tail_policy=explicit_zero_sample: caller-supplied explicit zero-frequency damping sample B(0); no substitution from finite frequencies
high_tail_truncated_at_omega_max=8: B is explicitly truncated at the last grid frequency; no extrapolation, fitting or symmetrization
kernel_artifact_unqualified: development artifact; cannot inherit qualified status from the source dataset

derived_operators_source: retained-coordinate kernel built from the admitted derived operator artifact (bound to its content hash and the raw source dataset hash); the raw full-6N source is not consumed here
